text:
alex: Quick follow-up from the token-validation postmortem. Consolidating owners and next steps so we can close remediation items. Pls ack and add notes. /cc @sana @diego :eyes:

sana: ack. I'll take the validation probe + alerting. Will add a probe to hit /health/token-validate and a prometheus rule. ETA: 48h.

diego: I'll handle the audit-log gap. Found that batch-ingestor-prod wasn't setting AUDIT_LOGGING=true in k8s template. Also saw stale token TTLs on a few service accounts.

lina: product request: we need a customer-impact matrix for forced rotations. Some customers use long-lived integration tokens; we should surface those before enforcement. Lina -> I'll owner the comms and migration paths.

alex: Action matrix (owner / due):
1) token validation probe + pager - sana - 48h
2) k8s env fix + re-ingest for missing events - diego - 24h (in progress)
3) legacy token rotation policy doc - lina - 5d
4) runbook + automated audit job - alex - next sprint

sana: probe I'm planning: `GET https://internal/api/v1/token/validate?probe=true` -> expect `{"ok": true}`. Alert if status != 200 or ok != true. Will post PR.

diego: logs snippet: ```ERROR authz: token check failed svc=batch-ingestor-prod err="audit disabled" src=authz/validation.go:178```

sana: good reproduction. diego: can you list affected SA names so we can rotate keys?

diego: affected: sa-batch-ingestor, sa-exporter-main. exporter-main has 2 tokens older than 365d. Rotating exporter-main now.

incbot: Incident 2149911000 - token-validation-drift - status: acknowledged (automated) :robot_face:

alex: noted. lina please tag customer-owned tokens in the migration doc so ops can exclude or schedule maintenance windows.

lina: will do. proposing phased enforcement: notify -> grace period -> mandatory rotation. Also adding a migration CLI snippet for customers.

sana: PR: https://github.com/redwood/observability/pull/517 (probe + prometheus rule)

diego: PR: https://github.com/redwood/platform/pull/2201 (k8s env fix + job to backfill audit events)

alex: diego said this is the 4th similar drift event in ~8 months for the exporter/batch families. We should add a recurring check and metric on drift rate. If drift > 3% over a week, auto-notify security and oncall.

lina: adding priority backlog item and will coordinate with growth for customer comms.

diego: ops note: re-ingest job scheduled, will verify audit events backfilled to the last 7 days.

sana: will wire weekly summary to #eng-sre and set a runbook link in the alert.

alex: I'll own runbook updates. Once PRs merge, paste confirmations here and I'll close the postmortem follow-up.

lina: migration doc draft: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/174

sana: probe merged, alert live. https://prometheus.redwood/alerts/ALRT-6209

diego: k8s fix merged, backfill job completed. Verified audit events for importer and batch-ingestor.

alex: great work. I'll update the retro slides and mark items closed. Thanks all. :trophy:
